data.description: Erlkings gain a +10 bonus on Bluff, Knowledge, Perception, Sense Motive, and Survival checks when using these skills against all humanoids. Likewise, they get a +10 bonus on weapon attack and damage rolls against such creatures. They may make Knowledge Skill checks untrained to identify such creatures.
data.name: Favored Enemy
